instructions.question: After typing the value into the chosen text field, should the Enter key be pressed immediately to submit (as with a search box or a single-field form)?
rules: Answer no when other fields still need values or when a separate submit button must be clicked after all fields are filled.

criteria.true: Pressing Enter right after typing is the natural way to submit this field (search boxes, single-field forms, the last field of a form).
criteria.false: More fields must be filled first, or a separate button should be clicked, or Enter would do nothing useful.
